question: Which actress-cum-dancer was honoured with the Padma Bhushan award in 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Waheeda Rehman.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Waheeda Rehman is a veteran actress and dancer who has worked in **Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and Bengali films.** 
 
• She has won several awards for her performances, including the **National Film Award** for Best Actress. 
 
• In** 2011**, Waheeda Rehman was honoured with the **Padma Bhushan award** for her contribution to Indian cinema.
 
• Some of her notable films include** "Guide", "Pyaasa", "Kabhi Kabhie"**, and** "Trishul"**.
 
• Waheeda Rehman is considered to be one of the finest actresses in Indian cinema and has **inspired generations of actors** with her performances.
